title: Rabbi Chiyya Barmaza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot cites him from Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 5, beginning of halakhah 2; the text Hyman uses reads Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba. Hyman reports Rabbi Chiyya Baruza in the Arukh entry שקל and Rabbi Chiyya Baruzah in the entry סאור of the Pesaro printing רל״ז.

notes.text: Hyman’s supplied printing date רל״ז is retained literally, without adding an unprovided millennium or a Gregorian equivalent. The Arukh entry names שקל and סאור and the Barmaza/Baruza/Baruzah variants remain distinct; the printing date itself has not been externally verified.
The consulted Yerushalmi paragraph has Chiyya bar Abba. Hyman reports the separate Arukh readings and the Pesaro printing date.
